speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient

I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; the rash suggests a penicillin allergy which explains the switch to cephalexin. Given your flank pain, fever, and fatigue, please tell me if you have noticed any blood in your urine or if your pain radiates to your groin?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is unexpected given your fever and flank pain. Please request the Urinalysis results I ordered immediately; does the pain worsen when you press on your lower back?

speaker: Patient
text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication.
